en: Colorized historic postcard view of a steel truss bridge leading toward a large fortified castle complex with round and square towers and red-tiled roofs. Soldiers in uniform are marching across the bridge toward the castle. A church tower is visible in the background, and utility poles line the right side. Printed titles in German identify the place as Torgau on the Elbe River and Schloss Hartenfels.
